details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. All statements build logically upon each other without contradictions. Revenue growth is consistently attributed to specific segments (LNG terminal, liquid energy products, consulting services). Profit metrics (operating profit, gross profit, net finance cost, profit before tax, net profit, EPS) show coherent progression. Segment profit comparisons align with overall profit trends. Cash flow, balance sheet items, and governance changes are presented as distinct but compatible elements of the financial picture. No arithmetic contradictions are present or implied, and there is no unnecessary repetition. The structure moves naturally from revenue through profit metrics to cash flow and balance sheet items, ending with governance updates.
